draftArchitecture.openingJob: Answer that the week brought real changes, but not all headlines describe the same kind of change.
draftArchitecture.plainAnswer: California created oversight deadlines and two data-centre duties; a federal ratepayer bill remains a proposal; a card-skimmer investigation reports risk; Claude and OpenAI changed product access.
causalSequence: Compare with the prior Weekly and introduce the verb test.
Connect California oversight and infrastructure measures while preserving study versus enacted duty.
Contrast the federal House proposal with enacted state law and actual rate decisions.
Translate the card-skimmer investigation without personal-exposure inference.
Close with two product-access changes and their plan/surface limits.
draftArchitecture.workedCase: A resident hears that data-centre laws protect her bill; trace enacted reporting and assessment duties separately from a proposed federal cost-allocation standard and an approved local rate.
draftArchitecture.transferCase: A shopper reads that AI agents deployed skimmers; distinguish an investigator’s observed campaign and estimates from proof that her own card was taken.
draftArchitecture.usefulAction: Ask which verb applies, who is covered, and what later decision or evidence is still required.
draftArchitecture.formatSpecificStructure: Weekly front read and highlights; connected Story sections; LAiDIES Read; What This Means; Cocktail Party; Watch fors; Class Notes; Sources.
draftArchitecture.antiTemplateDecision: Unequal sections based on consequence; no item quota, repeated mini-card formula or forced common cause.
